ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND ( AND( TEXT(Stage__c) != 'Visa In Progress', TEXT(Stage__c) != 'Pending Arrival', TEXT(Stage__c) != 'Arrived', TEXT(Stage__c) != 'Commission Received', TEXT(Stage__c) != 'Commission Paid' ), TEXT(Student_Confirm_Offer__c)='Yes' )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: IF Student conform offer is 'Yes' then Stage should be either 'Visa In Progress', 'Pending Arrival', 'Arrived', 'Commission Received' or 'Commission Paid'
